text: PET-CT for staging. FINDINGS: Hypermetabolic activity (SUV max 8.2) in the known right lower lobe mass measuring 3.5 cm. FDG-avid right paratracheal lymph node (SUV max 5.4). No evidence of distant metastatic disease. No bone lesions. Brain MRI (separate report) shows no intracranial metastases. STAGING: Clinical stage IIIA (T2aN2M0) based on imaging findings. Multidisciplinary tumor board discussion recommended.
